action.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== kosis all assets ==="; for f in $(grep -oE '(src|href)="[^"]+"' examples/kosis/kosisDemo.html | sed -E 's/(src|href)="//;s/"//' | sort -u); do case "$f" in http*|"#") continue;; esac; code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost:8080/examples/kosis/$f"); echo "$code  $f"; done
